items.raw_excerpt: The Chinese box office hit is drawing overseas visitors to the Chaoshan region, transforming filming locations into heritage tourism hotspots and raising questions about preservation and privacy.

items.raw_excerpt: Paul Davis has made it his mission to conserve his ecologically significant property, and he's bringing together a diverse group of people to help him do it.

items.raw_excerpt: The ACT Party is proposing to increase the proportion of health budget spent on Pharmac by one percent a year, to bring New Zealand in line with Australia and closer to the OECD average.

items.raw_excerpt: As junior oil and gas companies Pilot Energy and Triangle Energy enter voluntary administration, an aging oil rig is sitting idly at sea off the coast of WA's Midwest.

items.raw_excerpt: Gordon Howard Tilly was a 22-year-old electrical engineer when he arrived in Kalgoorlie-Boulder in 1911. Now his newly discovered diary is on public display, shedding light on life in the Goldfields a century ago.
items.summary_en: A diary from 1911 belonging to Gordon Howard Tilly has been discovered and put on public display. Tilly was a 22-year-old electrical engineer when he arrived in Kalgoorlie-Boulder over a century ago. The find sheds new light on daily life in the Western Australian Goldfields.

items.title_ko: 백 년 전 일기장이 전하는 골드필즈의 삶
